test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A class of 95 students took a Physics test. 47 students had an average score of 93. The other students had an average score of 54. What is the average score (rounded off to one decimal place) of the whole class?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume base average = 54.

Deviation for 47 students = 93 − 54 = +39.

Total deviation = 47 × 39 = 1833.

Net average increase = 1833 ÷ 95 ≈ 19.3.

Total Average = 54 + 19.3 = 73.3.

**∴ Answer = 73.3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total students in class = 95

Number of students in first group (n₁) = 47, Average score (A₁) = 93

Number of students in second group (n₂) = 95 − 47 = 48, Average score (A₂) = 54

**Formula used:**

Weighted Average = (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 48 Students (n₂) 47 Students (n₁) Avg: 54 Avg: 93 
• Total Average = 73.3

**Calculations:**

Sum of scores of 47 students = 47 × 93 = 4371

⇒ Sum of scores of 48 students = 48 × 54 = 2592

⇒ Total sum of scores = 4371 + 2592 = 6963

⇒ Average score of whole class = 6963 ÷ 95

⇒ Average score ≈ 73.2947

⇒ Average score (rounded to 1 decimal place) = 73.3

**∴ The correct answer is 73.3 (Option 1).**
